Terms of Service

Effective Date: July 22, 2026

These Terms of Service govern your use of the Country Roofing & Construction LLC website and our SMS text messaging program. By using our website, requesting our services, or choosing to receive text messages from us, you agree to these Terms of Service.

1. Acceptance of Terms

By accessing or using countryroofingandconstruction.com , submitting a request for services, or opting in to receive SMS text messages from Country Roofing & Construction LLC, you acknowledge that you have read and agree to these Terms of Service.

2. Our Services

Country Roofing & Construction LLC provides roofing, exterior renovation, repair, inspection, estimate, scheduling, and related construction services. Information provided through our website is intended for general informational and service-request purposes.

Submitting a form or requesting an estimate does not create a binding service agreement. Specific project terms, pricing, timelines, and responsibilities may be provided separately in an estimate, proposal, or contract.

3. Country Roofing & Construction LLC SMS Program

If you provide your phone number and choose to receive SMS text messages, Country Roofing & Construction LLC may send you informational messages related to your request or services, including:

  • Responses to inquiries and requests for information
  • Appointment scheduling and reminders
  • Estimate and inspection updates
  • Project and service updates
  • Customer support communications

Consent to receive SMS text messages is voluntary and is not a condition of purchasing any goods or services.

4. Message Frequency

Message frequency varies depending on your request, your interactions with Country Roofing & Construction LLC, and the services being provided. You may receive recurring messages while an inquiry, appointment, estimate, or project is active.

5. Message and Data Rates

Message and data rates may apply. Charges are determined by your wireless carrier and mobile service plan. Country Roofing & Construction LLC is not responsible for any messaging or data charges assessed by your carrier.

6. Opting Out and Getting Help

You may stop receiving SMS text messages at any time by replying STOP to any message from Country Roofing & Construction LLC. After you send STOP, you may receive a confirmation message, and no additional SMS messages will be sent unless you opt in again.

For assistance with the SMS program, reply HELP to any message or contact us using the information in the Contact Us section below.

7. Supported Carriers and Message Delivery

SMS delivery depends on your wireless carrier, device, network availability, and other factors outside our control. Carriers are not liable for any delayed or undelivered messages.

8. Privacy

Your privacy is important to us. Our collection, use, storage, and sharing of personal information, including phone numbers and SMS consent information, is described in our Privacy Policy.

We make reasonable efforts to keep the information on our website accurate and current, but we do not guarantee that all content will always be complete, accurate, or available. We may update, remove, or modify website content and services at any time.

We are not responsible for interruptions caused by maintenance, technical issues, third-party services, network failures, or events outside our reasonable control.

10. Third-Party Links

Our website may contain links to third-party websites or services. Country Roofing & Construction LLC does not control and is not responsible for the content, availability, privacy practices, or terms of those third-party websites.

11. Changes to These Terms

We may update these Terms of Service from time to time to reflect changes in our services, business practices, legal obligations, or SMS program requirements. Updated terms will be posted on this page with a revised effective date.

Your continued use of our website or SMS program after updated terms are posted means that you accept the revised Terms of Service.
